sources.text: Authored fictional scenario: the Fictional C4 Demo Office requires application registration, preparation and submission. Each stage costs LKR 0. Registration must finish before preparation starts. The two required preparation actions are preparing a fictional completed application form and preparing a fictional supporting copy. These actions are explicitly independent of each other after registration and may be performed in either order or concurrently. Both must finish before submission, which requires both documents. There are no alternative branches or applicability conditions within this complete fictional scenario. The preparation pair is the only explicit parallel group.
